headline: Pakistan's National Emergency Operations Center said on Saturday that over 23.4 million children were vaccinated in the first five days of the sub-national anti-polio campaign that began Monday in 97 districts, Arab News reports.

card.desc: 97 districts mein polio muhim jari, NEOC ne bataya

caption:
Polio muhim ke 5 din mein 23.4 million se zyada bachon ko qatre pilaye gaye!
Arab News ke mutabiq NEOC ne Saturday ko bataya ke Monday se shuru hone wali polio muhim ke pehle 5 din mein 23.4 million se zyada bachon ki vaccination hui. 97 districts mein 24 million bachon ka hadaf hai, aur is saal ab tak 9 polio cases report hue hain.
Kya aap ke bachon ko polio ke qatre pilaye gaye? Comment mein batayein 👇
